estimators.ratio: per (build, W, R): mean over rounds of (t_band - t_twin) / crossings and of t_band / t_twin, band and twin paired within each round, BCa 95% interval (METHODOLOGY.md §24.2)
estimators.columns: per-cell owner elapsed seconds and reader Mops/s are means over rounds with a BCa 95% interval; medians are auxiliary; counters are summed over rounds
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

band_cells.schedule: within round r the 28 (build, duty, W, R) cells follow row r of the Williams construction over them; one harness process per cell with a load window around each; the throughput pass runs every round before the counters pass

p24_1.note: P24.1 is met only when both runs of §24.3 read PASS_this_run
